_comment: Per-field value guide (generated by scripts/build_value_guide.py from schema.json). Tells a filler what each field should contain, with formats, address components, calculations to validate, and adversarial values to avoid. Not legal advice.

county.label: County
county.expects: a Maine county name WITHOUT the word 'County' (the form prints 'COUNTY'); rendered upper-case

docket_number.label: Docket Number
avoid: a docket from another jurisdiction's format

estate_of_decedent.label: Estate Of Decedent
estate_of_decedent.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

petitioner_info.label: Petitioner Info
petitioner_info.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

decedent_death_date.label: Decedent Death Date
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

probate_date.label: Probate Date
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

election_extension_status.label: Election Extension Status

probate_estate_value.label: Probate Estate Value
probate_estate_value.expects: a dollar amount, digits and decimal point only
avoid: a '$' character inside the value (the form prints it)
a negative amount unless this line is explicitly a credit

augmented_estate_value.expects: a dollar amount, digits and decimal point only
